subject: Gender Identity Non-Discrimination Policy
overview: School Committee members Sharon Hays and Melanie McLaughlin discussed a proposed gender identity non-discrimination policy designed to protect LGBTQ+ students and formalize access to gender-neutral facilities. The conversation also covered district-wide efforts to improve student representation and community engagement.

items.title: Introductions and local favorites
items.summary: Guests introduced themselves and shared recommendations for local Medford restaurants.

items.title: Origin of the gender identity non-discrimination policy
items.summary: Sharon Hays explained that the policy was developed after meetings with the high school Gender and Sexuality Alliance, where students identified a lack of formal policy regarding gender-neutral bathrooms.

items.title: DEI subcommittee function
items.summary: Melanie McLaughlin explained how subcommittees allow the School Committee to address specialized topics and encouraged community members to reach out to chairs for meetings on specific issues.

items.title: Draft policy provisions
items.summary: The proposed policy includes protections for student names and pronouns, guidelines for transitions, bathroom and locker room access, and privacy of student records.

items.title: Policy revisions and next steps
items.summary: Sections on athletics and dress codes were removed to avoid duplicating existing district policies, and a second reading is scheduled for late November.

items.title: Community and student engagement
items.summary: The guests discussed the importance of proactive outreach to marginalized families and the upcoming election of a student advisory committee to meet with school leadership.

items.title: District-wide non-discrimination requirements
items.summary: Melanie McLaughlin highlighted a requirement that all district documents include non-discrimination statements and information on how to request accommodations.
